description: This file defines structures and functions related to node affinity and scheduling in Kubernetes, including node selector parsing, matching, and scoring.

classes.name: NodeSelector
classes.description: Represents a node selector with lazy error reporting.

classes.name: LazyErrorNodeSelector
classes.description: Represents a node selector that reports parse errors only when no terms match.

classes.name: PreferredSchedulingTerms
classes.description: Represents preferred scheduling terms for node selection.

classes.name: nodeSelectorTerm
classes.description: Represents a single node selector term with label and field matchers.

classes.name: RequiredNodeAffinity
classes.description: Encapsulates node affinity requirements for scheduling.

methods.name: NewNodeSelector
methods.description: Creates a NodeSelector from a v1.NodeSelector, aggregating parse errors.

methods.name: NewLazyErrorNodeSelector
methods.description: Creates a LazyErrorNodeSelector that reports parse errors only if no terms match.

methods.name: Match
methods.description: Checks if a node matches the node selector criteria.

methods.name: Match
methods.description: Checks if a node matches the lazy node selector, returning errors if any.

methods.name: NewPreferredSchedulingTerms
methods.description: Creates preferred scheduling terms, skipping terms with zero weight or empty preferences.

methods.name: Score
methods.description: Calculates a score for a node based on matching preferred scheduling terms.

methods.name: newNodeSelectorTerm
methods.description: Constructs a nodeSelectorTerm from a v1.NodeSelectorTerm.

methods.name: match
methods.description: Determines if a node's labels and fields match the selector term.

methods.name: GetRequiredNodeAffinity
methods.description: Returns node affinity requirements for a pod, including label and node selector.

methods.name: Match
methods.description: Checks if a node satisfies the required node affinity for a pod.
